question: Which of the following organisations is responsible for the development of the Long-Range Glide Bomb (LRGB), GAURAV, tested in August 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) **is responsible for developing the Long-Range Glide Bomb (LRGB), GAURAV. **
 
• The DRDO** successfully tested the Gaurav LRGB for the first time on August 13, 2024. **
 
• The Gaurav is a 1**,000 kg glide bomb** that can be launched from the air and hit targets from a long distance. 
 
• The Gaurav** uses a combination of GPS and INS data **to steer towards its target. 
 
• The Gaurav **was developed by the Research Centre Imarat (RCI) in Hyderabad**. 
 
• The Gaurav was tested from a Su-30 MK-I fighter jet of the Indian Air Force (IAF) off the coast of Odisha. 
 
• The Gaurav is part of a family of precision guided munitions with a range of 50–150 km. 
 
• The Gaurav was developed as an alternative to the Spice 2000.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO):

 
• DRDO was formed in 1958 from the amalgamation of the then already functioning Technical Development Establishment (TDEs) of the Indian Army and the Directorate of Technical Development & Production (DTDP) with the Defence Science Organisation (DSO).
 
• DRDO is the R&D wing of Ministry of Defence, Govt of India, with a vision to empower India with cutting-edge defence technologies.
 
• The vision is empowering the nation with state-of-the-art indigenous Defence technologies and systems.
 
• DRDO is a network of more than 50 laboratories which are deeply engaged in developing defence technologies covering various disciplines, like aeronautics, armaments, electronics, combat vehicles, engineering systems, instrumentation, missiles, advanced computing and simulation, special materials, naval systems, life sciences, training, information systems and agriculture.
 
• DRDO's pursuit of self-reliance and successful indigenous development and production of strategic systems and platforms such as Agni and Prithvi series of missiles; light combat aircraft, Tejas; multi-barrel rocket launcher, Pinaka; air defence system, Akash; a wide range of radars and electronic warfare systems; etc., have given quantum jump to India's military might, generating effective deterrence and providing crucial leverage.
